name: top30-ui
description: EasyUI's workflow, reverse-engineered, plus motion forensics. motion-component-builder builds animated React components to one standard; component-registry publishes them as a shadcn GitHub registry; motion-forensics diagnoses how a site's motion is really built (canvas, WebGL, timelines, smooth scroll, CSS) and rebuilds scroll-driven canvas scenes; agents: ui-reverse-engineer and motion-detective.
